notes.title: Cubin is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Player 422, it's your turn!

Cubin is now available on Steam!

A game that immerses you in the LGA experience. During your journey, you'll meet Alice, who will help and guide you through the finer points of the experience. Pick up the gravity cube and interact with the control room to complete and pass through a new, ever more complex experiment.
Prepare to think, glide, fly, explode and also encounter failure. Discover yourself, who you really are on this adventure, how far you can go...

At the same time, discover what lies behind this rather dubious experiment.

[previewyoutube=U6GH66AV95E;full][/previewyoutube]

Game features:

Complete 60 increasingly complex experiments
6 different endings
Use the control room to get an overview of the experiment 
Press the buzzer in the control room to activate an event during an experiment.
Get to know Alice, who will help and guide you throughout your experiment.
Easy to learn and fully customizable


You can now grab a copy of Cubin with a %10 launch discount.

We hope you enjoy the game and the story, we've put a lot of work into it. We'll be listening to you and improving the game with your feedback.
Thank you for your confidence.

notes.title: Cubin Demo 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Cubin Demo! We listen your feedback a lot to improve the game. 
Here's a first update (and details of previous patches) to improve the demo:

Cubin just reached 750 wishlists, thank you very much!

1.1.0 Update details:

Added setting: Hold cube with one click
Added setting: FOV
Modification of blindness rooms: once the control room button has been pressed, it is now possible to press it again to reactivate the lights every 15s
Improved wall texture
Fixed the inability to teleport once the key has been shown in the tutorial
Fixed cube interaction delay
Fixed hole in the glass model
Settings optimization


Old update details (1.0.1 - 1.0.5):

Changes to level 03
Change of certain light intensities
Fixed the timer at the end of the demo, which was not correct
Fixed the use key that stayed on the screen even when away of tapes
Fixed elevator doors that froze when fps was equal to or less than 60
Fixed the cube outline that was not visible in the tutorial
Fixed the Continue button, which was clickable even if a game hadn't started
Fixed particles when deactivating alice's voice
Fixed version displayed that was not updated
Game optimization
